newsitem.title: USA: HRE Properties start talks to recover rent.
newsitem.headline: HRE Properties start talks to recover rent.

text.p: HRE Properties said on Tuesday it started talks with one of its net lease tenants to recover up to $6.2 million in unpaid back rent, including interest.

HRE, owner of community shopping centers primarily in the Northeast, said the rents owed are from violation of a lease requiring the tenant to compensate HRE for decreases in percentage rent resulting from the opening of competing stores within a specified radius.
Mark Wasserman, vice president of HRE's investor relations firm D.F. King and Co, declined to name the tenant in a telephone interview.
"It is a nationally known retail chain," Wasserman said.
